title.rendered: Progress Video – New High School Site – 1/30/2019

content.rendered: Please view the latest aerial video, from January 30, 2019, of progress made on the new high school.  This amazing video features live action footage of the Skanska crew at work and the installation of the tilt panels that make up the future gym.
